mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in FEDFUNDS over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL crossing above 233.5 predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as inflation acceleration drives market optimism.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 233.5 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when trigger occurs (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 (demand) and PAYEMS (labor) signal expanding economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and PAYEMS increase over the past month
failure_condition: Combined effect not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE drop below 7.5% in late-cycle expansion predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as labor market tightness improves.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 7.5% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns negative despite UNRATE drop in this regime.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.0% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative when trigger occurs (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly rises in GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (demand) predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as aggregate demand strengthens.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and RSAFS increase over the past month
failure_condition: No significant positive returns when both proxies rise (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO crossing above 100 in late-cycle expansion predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as supply-side growth signals recovery.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses above 100 in the next month
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive when trigger occurs (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS exceeding 136,000 in the next month signals strong labor market participation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 136,000 in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when PAYEMS crosses threshold.
